title: Korn Ferry Earns Top Recognition as Overall No. 1 RPO Provider in HRO Today’s Baker’s Dozen List
summary: Korn Ferry has been recognized as the No. 1 Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) provider by HRO Today’s Baker’s Dozen Customer Satisfaction Rating.
body_markdown:
**Los Angeles, September 24, 2026** – Korn Ferry (NYSE: KFY), a global leader in talent and organizational consulting, has been recognized as the No. 1 Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) provider by *HRO Today’s* Baker’s Dozen Customer Satisfaction Rating.


The annual list is selected based on an extensive survey of and rating by RPO buyers. In addition to being the No. 1 overall RPO provider, Korn Ferry was also recognized as a leader in quality of service.


“We are honored to be recognized by clients as the top global RPO provider,” said Jeanne MacDonald, CEO of Recruitment Process Outsourcing at Korn Ferry. “This recognition reflects the strength of our people, our client partnerships and our ability to help organizations connect talent and strategy in a fast-changing world. At a time when organizations are rethinking how work gets done and where future growth will come from, talent has never been more central to business performance.”


Korn Ferry complements its RPO expertise with talent intelligence, workforce strategy and advisory capabilities to help clients address skills shortages, workforce planning and AI-driven change—aligning talent decisions with broader business priorities.


Now combined with AMS, Korn Ferry brings together broad capabilities, expanded global reach and deep expertise across the talent lifecycle.


“Korn Ferry is now one of the largest RPO providers in the world following the successful completion of the merger with AMS. What is remarkable is that they have been able to maintain a very high level of service experience for their clients. Korn Ferry has the ability to do large, complex, global RPO programs with the newest technologies and does so in a way that is still placing them at the very top of the RPO Bakers Dozen list. In addition, their clients are consuming a variety of related services offered by Korn Ferry and seem positive on the overall experience”, according to Elliot Clark, CEO of *HRO Today* Magazine.


**About Korn Ferry**


Korn Ferry is a global consulting firm that powers performance. We unlock the potential in your people and unleash transformation across your business—synchronizing strategy, operations, and talent to accelerate performance, fuel growth, and inspire a legacy of change. That’s why the world’s most forward-thinking companies across every major industry turn to us—for a shared commitment to lasting impact and the bold ambition to *Be More Than* .


As the Official Talent & Organizational Consulting Partner of LA28, Korn Ferry is powering the nearly 5,000 people who power the Olympic Games—bringing in the right talent, building strong leaders, and shaping the structure and culture that will deliver an unforgettable experience for the world.
